title: Bound XML signature references
goal: Reject XML signatures exceeding a deliberate reference budget; configure the parser before first use and retain separate input limits, trusted-key and authorization checks.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against .NET 11 references; exact RC2 pins are verification baselines.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical declared language mode; no preview syntax switch.

packages.name: System.Security.Cryptography.Xml
packages.reason: Current reference-budget configuration; exact RC2 package and matching transitive Pkcs are locked in the sample.

packageAssets: System.Security.Cryptography.Xml lib/net11.0; matching transitive System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs. No net10/new-package execution claim.
prerequisites: Nullable/implicit-usings console project; internal canonical helper called from its assembly.
Initialize the positive reference budget before any cryptographic XML settings are cached.
Input XmlDocument already parsed with bounded/prohibited-DTD/null-resolver settings; enforce expected IDs/references separately.
platforms: Windows x64 CoreCLR measured; other runtimes/platforms unverified.
providers: Windows CNG RSA2048/SHA256; other providers unverified.
stabilityLimitations: Not marked experimental in the audited contract. Actual RC2 evidence, not final-GA verification; PIN-959/PIN-962 remain open.
constraints: Configure System.Security.Cryptography.MaxReferencesPerSignedInfo once before cryptographic XML initializes cached settings; process-wide, not per request.
Use a positive budget; preserve DTD/resolver/transform protections, input-size limits, expected-reference validation and trusted-key policy. A valid signature is not authorization.
Paired net10/Xml10 and net11/Xml11 consumers; no verified net10/new-package backport. Windows x64 CNG RSA executed.
